انطبعن (form VII)
# اِنْطَبَعْنَ (inṭabaʕna) /in.tˤa.baʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# اِنْطَبِعْنَ (inṭabiʕna) /in.tˤa.biʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
